STATE OF WASHINGTON
OFFICE OF THE GOVERNOR
OFFICE OF PROGRAM PLANNING AND FISCAL MANAGEMENT
HOUSE OFFICE BUILDING
OLYMPIA. WASHINGTON 98504
JOHN W. MCCURRY
206-753-5450
DANIEL J. EVANS GOVERNOR
June 12, 1972
Chief, Office of Environmental Quality Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife U.S. Department of the Interior Washington D.C. 20240
Dear Sir:
Re: Draft Environmental Statement on H.R.1311, DES-72-44 Proposed Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972
In conjunction with the requirements of Section 102 (2)(c) of the Pational Environmental Policy Act of 1969, the Office of Program Planning and Fiscal Management is forwarding the enclosed state agency responses to the above referenced environmental statement.
This Office having been designated by the Governor as the state clearing-house for A-95 review has coordinated the analysis of this draft statement. That review has indicated certain areas of concern which are discussed at length in the four copied responses.
We commend you for this important action of great interest and concern to citizens of our state. Our many suggestions are sincerely intended to assist you in preparing your final draft, which we will look forward to receiving.
Yours truly,
STATE PLANNING DIVISION
Micholas D. Leria
State Planner
